name: Real native write trial through the production path
description: The native capability specified by Task 20 (25 §11, 05 Group U RT-006): the harness acts as composition root and binds the SHIPPED handler.save-files factory to the scenario's explicitly declared, isolated workspace — no scenario handler is injected, and the Hotkey Runtime, Agent, Tool Bus, Module Registry, Composition, approval GATE, and Report Bus are all real. The primary run creates exactly one UTF-8 file; the overwrite leg re-saves it with new content (R2 create-or-overwrite); the gated legs prove the single GATE precedes every write — without approval the run refuses at GATE with zero agent calls and no file appears, with an explicit grant the same write executes after exactly one verification.

plan.task: Create the native-write trial file in the scenario workspace

changes.why: prove the production native save path end to end

verification: read back rt-006.md and compare the reported sha256
risks: the write must stay inside the isolated scenario workspace

args.content: RT-006: created by handler.save-files through the production path.
